data: Does the model trained with the entire training set have higher performance than the model trained with 50% of the training data?

The question asks whether the model trained with the entire training set has higher performance than the model trained with 50% of the training data. From the analysis of the figure:

1. The blue line represents the model trained with the entire training set.
2. The orange line represents the model trained with 50% of the training data.
3. At the end of the training epochs (approximately 140), the F1 score for the blue line is approximately 0.85, while the F1 score for the orange line is approximately 0.78.

Based on this information, the model trained with the entire training set has a higher F1 score than the model trained with 50% of the training data. Therefore, the answer is yes.
